about.subTitle: I'm a senior software engineer with over 7 years of experience building scalable backend systems and full-stack applications, currently pursuing a BSc in Mathematics and Computer Science at UNISA. My core focus is Python backend development — FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis — with a strong track record across AI platforms, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.

section1.title: Soft Skills That Pay the Bills
section1.copy: Beyond technical depth, I bring strong leadership and architectural thinking refined through leading teams, mentoring engineers, and owning long-term technical roadmaps. I approach problems with evidence-based rigour — diagnosing root causes before committing to solutions. Outside work I stay sharp through gym and basketball, which keep the discipline and competitive drive alive.

section2.title: Research and Planning
section2.copy: I find the most leverage in the architecture and design phases of a project. Whether decomposing a microservices system, designing database schemas for scale, or planning zero-downtime migration strategies, I invest heavily upfront to avoid costly rework downstream.
